description: Header file defining the SpdyFramer class and related classes for SPDY protocol frame serialization, including methods for creating frame sequences, serializing various frame types, and managing HPACK header compression.

classes.name: SpdyFrameSequence
classes.description: Abstract class representing a sequence of SPDY frames for serialization.

classes.name: SpdyFramer
classes.description: Main class responsible for serializing SPDY protocol frames, managing HPACK compression, and creating frame sequences.

classes.name: SpdyFramer::SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for converting a SpdyFrameIR into a sequence of frames.

classes.name: SpdyFramer::SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for converting a SpdyHeadersIR with large header blocks into multiple frames.

classes.name: SpdyFramer::SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for converting a SpdyPushPromiseIR with large header blocks into multiple frames.

classes.name: SpdyFramer::SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Converts a single SpdyFrameIR into a single SPDY frame for output.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates a frame sequence iterator for a given frame IR.

methods.name: SerializeDataFrameHeaderWithPaddingLengthField
methods.description: Serializes data frame header with optional padding length.

methods.name: SerializeFrame
methods.description: Serializes a frame with optional output parameter.

methods.name: compression_enabled
methods.description: Checks if header compression is enabled.

methods.name: SetHpackIndexingPolicy
methods.description: Sets the HPACK header indexing policy.

methods.name: UpdateHeaderEncoderTableSize
methods.description: Updates the maximum size of the HPACK header table.

methods.name: header_encoder_table_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the HPACK header table.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoder (const)
methods.description: Returns the HPACK encoder instance (const version).
